envelope.summary: Harbourview Tower is a Class A Canary Wharf office owned 100% by Meridian via Harbourview Tower SPV Limited. Current independent valuation is GBP 92.8m with strong document provenance and moderate lease-roll risk.

timeline.title: Acquisition completed
timeline.description: Meridian acquired 100% of Harbourview Tower SPV Limited for GBP 86.4m.

timeline.title: Insurance renewed
timeline.description: All-risks property policy renewed with a GBP 95m declared value.

timeline.title: Independent valuation
timeline.description: Knightvale valued the asset at GBP 92.8m on an income capitalization basis.

valuation.method: Income capitalization with recent comparable evidence
notes: Passing rent and WALT support a 5.35% cap rate.
Valuer applied a 4% vacancy allowance versus 6% in-place.

dimensions.label: Ownership clarity
dimensions.rationale: 100% legal title is documented through the SPA and land registry extract.

dimensions.label: Document coverage
dimensions.rationale: Title, SPA, valuation, insurance and KYC packs are present and current.

dimensions.label: Income durability
dimensions.rationale: Occupancy is 94% but three major leases expire within 36 months.

dimensions.label: Jurisdiction & legal
dimensions.rationale: England & Wales title is clean; no material litigation disclosed.

envelope.summary: Aurelia Private Credit Fund III is a USD 48.25m NAV position in senior secured mid-market loans. Document coverage is solid; credit watchlist concentration is the primary risk driver.

timeline.title: Final close
timeline.description: Fund III reached final close at USD 1.1bn.

valuation.method: NAV plus expected credit loss overlay
notes: Fund NAV is USD 48.25m after ECL of 1.8%.
Two watchlist names drive most residual uncertainty.

dimensions.label: Credit quality
dimensions.rationale: Weighted average internal rating is BB- with 8% watchlist.

dimensions.label: Document coverage
dimensions.rationale: LPA, latest NAV pack and KYC are on file.

dimensions.label: Liquidity
dimensions.rationale: Closed-end fund with 2029 harvest window.

dimensions.label: Governance
dimensions.rationale: Independent GP with standard LPAC rights.

envelope.summary: Kline Collection — Untitled (1967) is a color-field canvas with exhibition provenance from 1998. Current fair value is USD 6.75m with elevated authenticity and liquidity risk relative to core real assets.

dimensions.label: Liquidity
dimensions.rationale: Sale would likely require a 6–9 month consignment window.

copilotMessages.content: What is the current value and the main risk on Harbourview Tower?

Harbourview Tower is marked at GBP 92.8m as of 30 June 2026, up from the GBP 86.4m acquisition price. Overall risk is moderate (34). The dominant issues are single-asset concentration in Canary Wharf and a lease-expiry cluster in 2029, despite 94% occupancy and a 7.4-year WALT.
